text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaah...! Seii!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...My mind is clear and dignified...
It was the right choice to come all the way to our dojo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will confront myself and discover my own appeal.
Then the performance for the fan gathering will—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear, look at that!
With this many holes, we can't use it for the tournament.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Dojo Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Yaeno-san! Well, we took out this banner
for the first time in a while and it's in terrible shape.
We were just talking about buying a replacement...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...Could you leave that banner in my care?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This banner has watched over generations of dojo students.
It is far better if we can continue using it.

text_block_list.name: Dojo Student B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? B-But...
aren't you busy, Yaeno-san...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
No, let's leave it to her.
It might serve as a good breather for her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...This cloth seems suitable.
If I hand-wash it a few times to fade the color,
it should match the shade of the banner.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: After that, using the same embroidery thread as the dojo name—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. I have finished repairing it,
so please take a look.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this looks wonderful.
You can't even see the seams—it's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Because the tear was quite large, I deliberately cut into the fabric
and sewed it together from the dojo's embroidered name...
tailoring it so that no seams or distortions would show.

text_block_list.name: Dojo Student A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Yaeno-san, I didn't know you were great
at this kind of thing in addition to martial arts...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call myself... "great" at it.
I have merely had many occasions to practice sewing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right.
You were always running around so energetically
that you were constantly tearing your clothes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"Take care of your own things."
That's our family motto, so I taught her
to mend her clothes herself, but—

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ow... OWWCH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, pricked yourself with the needle again, did you?
Here, put down your uniform for a moment. Let's get a bandage—

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No!! I'll keep going!
...I will do this...!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely... definitely, definitely!
I will master this no matter what...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her teachings and countless failures,
I acquired the skill. ...However,

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
one could say this is merely the result of getting furious
at my own clumsiness and refusing to give up.
...It is too embarrassing to call a special skill.

text_block_list.name: Dojo Student A
text_block_list.text: ...Th-That's amazing...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Dojo Student A
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible!! There's nothing embarrassing about it at all!
I'll... do my best with that kind of burning spirit too!!

text_block_list.name: Dojo Student B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Like smashing through walls with raw fighting spirit!
I've always respected that attitude of yours!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ! ...My... fighting spirit...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
............ Everyone, thank you.
Thanks to you, I have gained a wonderful realization.

One day, while walking through the academy grounds...
Yaeno Muteki called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for speaking to me
the other day when I was troubled.
choice_data_list: Are the preparations for your performance going well?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have no more doubts.
All that remains is to carry out what must be done...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If your schedule permits,
please come to the gathering.
I would like you to bear witness to my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What I must do is now clear.
I only hope they will be pleased with it...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If your schedule permits,
please come to the gathering.
